ai.note: Primary stress on AY, secondary on EYE — inverted from the auto-discovered ˌeɪˈaɪ to remove the audible beat between letters on Chirp HD (same fix shape as SSRI in index.js).

beir.note: BEIR (Biological Effects of Ionizing Radiation, US NAS report series) is pronounced 'beer'.

fhir.note: HL7 FHIR — pronounced "fire" by EMR-integration audiences.

hipaa.note: HIPAA — pronounced "HIP-uh" as a word, not letter-spelled.

json.note: JAY-sonn (as in sonnet), not letter-spelled J-S-O-N

sirt.note: SIRT (sirtuin gene family) is pronounced as a word (rhymes with shirt), not letter-spelled. SIRT1-SIRT7 phoneme-wrapped in preprocessForTTS; this entry covers bare SIRT references.

unscear.note: UNSCEAR (UN Scientific Committee on the Effects of Atomic Radiation) is pronounced 'un-scare'.

z-e-u-s.note: ZEUS (cardiovascular outcomes trial, ziltivekimab). Greek-god pronunciation — one syllable /zuːs/, rhymes with 'loose'. The auto-llm result ˈzjuəs (two syllables, 'ZYOO-uhss') sounded like 'zay-oose'.
